days.title: What is a System? - Interconnected Parts Working Together
days.learning_objective: Define systems as interconnected elements that work together, producing emergent behaviors and outcomes.

days.title: Parts and Wholes - How Pieces Make Patterns
days.learning_objective: Understand the relationship between individual components and the larger patterns they create together.

days.title: Connections and Relationships - How Parts Influence Each Other
days.learning_objective: Recognize that relationships between parts are often more important than the parts themselves.

days.title: Feedback Loops - Self-Reinforcing Patterns
days.learning_objective: Identify feedback loops—both reinforcing and balancing—that drive system behavior over time.

days.title: Unintended Consequences - Actions Have Ripple Effects
days.learning_objective: Anticipate that actions in complex systems often have unintended and far-reaching consequences.

days.title: Emergence - The Whole Is More Than the Sum
days.learning_objective: Understand emergence—how complex behaviors arise from simple interactions in ways that cannot be predicted from parts alone.

days.title: Scale - Small, Medium, Large Systems
days.learning_objective: Recognize systems at different scales and how they nest within each other.

days.title: Time and Systems - How Systems Evolve
days.learning_objective: Understand that systems change over time and that short-term and long-term dynamics often differ.

days.title: AI as a System - Understanding AI Architecturally
days.learning_objective: View AI systems through a systems lens, understanding inputs, processes, outputs, and feedback.

days.title: You as a System - Body, Mind, Environment
days.learning_objective: See yourself as a system with interconnected physical, mental, and environmental elements.

days.title: Learning Systems - Education as a Complex System
days.learning_objective: Understand education as a complex system with multiple stakeholders, goals, and dynamics.

days.title: Social Systems - Communities and Societies
days.learning_objective: Apply systems thinking to understand social dynamics, communities, and societal patterns.

days.title: Economic Systems - Money, Trade, Value
days.learning_objective: Understand economic systems as complex networks of exchange, incentives, and value creation.

days.title: Ecological Systems - Nature's Interconnections
days.learning_objective: Appreciate ecosystems as models of complex, self-organizing, adaptive systems.

days.title: Information Systems - How Data Flows
days.learning_objective: Understand how information moves through systems and shapes behavior and decisions.

days.title: Technology Systems - How Tools Connect
days.learning_objective: See technology as interconnected systems that shape and are shaped by human behavior.

days.title: System Maps - Visualizing Connections
days.learning_objective: Create and read system maps that visualize relationships, flows, and feedback loops.

days.title: Leverage Points - Where Small Changes Have Big Effects
days.learning_objective: Identify leverage points where small interventions can produce significant system-wide changes.

days.title: System Traps - Patterns That Cause Problems
days.learning_objective: Recognize common system traps like tragedy of the commons, shifting the burden, and policy resistance.

days.title: System Resilience - Bouncing Back from Disruption
days.learning_objective: Understand what makes systems resilient and able to recover from shocks and changes.

days.title: System Adaptation - Changing with Circumstances
days.learning_objective: Recognize adaptive systems that learn and change in response to their environment.

days.title: Mental Models - How We Understand Systems
days.learning_objective: Examine the mental models you use to understand systems and consider alternatives.

days.title: Seeing Patterns - Recognizing Recurring Structures
days.learning_objective: Develop the ability to recognize patterns that recur across different types of systems.

days.title: Thinking in Loops - Circular Causation
days.learning_objective: Move beyond linear cause-and-effect to understand circular causation and feedback.

days.title: Long-Term Thinking - Systems Change Slowly
days.learning_objective: Develop patience for long-term system change and recognize delays in system responses.

days.title: Complexity and Simplicity - When to Simplify
days.learning_objective: Balance appreciation for complexity with the practical need for simplification.

days.title: Uncertainty and Systems - Embracing Unknowns
days.learning_objective: Accept that complex systems are inherently unpredictable and learn to work with uncertainty.

days.title: Systems Problems - Wicked Problems with No Easy Solutions
days.learning_objective: Recognize 'wicked problems' that resist simple solutions and require ongoing adaptation.

days.title: Systems Solutions - Working with Complexity
days.learning_objective: Develop approaches for addressing complex problems that work with system dynamics rather than against them.

days.title: Systems Practice - Applying Systems Thinking Daily
days.learning_objective: Apply systems thinking habits to everyday situations and decisions.

days.title: Month in Review - Thinking in Systems
days.learning_objective: Integrate systems thinking as a fundamental lens for understanding the world.
